title: Supreme Court acquits man after 22 years in jail for wrongful conviction
content: After enduring twenty-two long years of wrongful imprisonment, a man was finally acquitted by the Supreme Court. The injustice stemmed from the trial court's flawed evidence analysis, compounded by the High Court's refusal to entertain his delayed appeal. The Supreme Court emphasized how marginalized communities often find access to justice frustratingly elusive, shedding light on the pressing issues within the judicial system that disproportionately affect the underprivileged.

title: Seven CWG golds, one big challenge: Why India's boxing journey is far from over

Indian boxing's journey continues towards Olympic aspirations and global recognition.

title: 2026's first total solar eclipse on August 12: Where to watch and what to avoid
content: A total solar eclipse will cross Europe on August 12, casting parts of Spain into darkness.  This rare event coincides with lunar perigee and the Perseid meteor shower.  Viewers in Spain will experience totality for over a minute, while other regions see partial eclipses.  The European Space Agency will stream the eclipse live online for global audiences.  Safe viewing practices, including certified eclipse glasses, are strongly recommended for all observers.

title: BCCI to standardise Bronco, 2K fitness test parameters after ENG tour debacle
content: The Indian team went through a change in fitness testing drills after Adrian Leroux replaced Soham Desai as the strength and conditioning coach last year. It is learnt that the BCCI medical team, which includes the CoE and the Indian team, has struggled to work in sync to assess the fitness of players. Since Leroux took over, it was decided that the Bronco test would be the primary test to judge fitness instead of the Yo-Yo test.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
content: OpenAI's Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant donation helped Friends of Big Bear Valley reach their ten million dollar goal.  The land will now be purchased by the San Bernardino Mountains Land Trust for conservation.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors contributed to the fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie is receiving veterinary care for severe anemia.

title: Meet Seungah Chung, who used 200 ants to reveal how they navigate
content: A bright young student embarked on a fascinating ant navigation experiment fueled by her natural curiosity. Through her meticulous research, she uncovered that ants primarily depend on visual markers for navigation. This groundbreaking project garnered her acclaim at a well-regarded science competition, showcasing the potential of such findings to inspire the development of innovative robots and autonomous systems.

title: Kazakhstan releases first wild tiger in 70 years after extinction
content: Kazakhstan has released adult Amur tigers into the wild after a 70-year absence.  This reintroduction follows extensive habitat preparation and prey population restoration efforts.  Scientists confirmed the genetic similarity between extinct Turanian and current Amur tiger populations.  The country has implemented a comprehensive conflict-prevention system for human-tiger coexistence.  This significant conservation initiative aims to re-establish tigers in their historic Central Asian range.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: Nagpur rape accused wants soft bedding, pizza in lock-up: Cops
content: A 20-year-old BBA student faces abduction and sexual assault charges. He is demanding luxury amenities and refusing police questioning. The accused also refuses medical treatment and to share passwords. He alleges police highhandedness and theft of cash from his flat. Police are monitoring him for self-harm and seeking digital evidence.

title: From DF-11 to DF-27: What China has in its regional ballistic missile arsenal
content: China's ballistic missile stockpile plays a pivotal role in bolstering its military influence in the region. The People's Liberation Army Rocket Force commands a diverse array of missiles, including short, medium, and intermediate ranges, specifically designed to strike military installations, naval forces, and essential infrastructure in the Indo-Pacific sphere. With cutting-edge models like the DF-17 and DF-26 in their arsenal, China extends its reach, emphasizing its relentless military modernization efforts.

title: Candace Owens faces backlash over Charlie Kirk investigation claims
content: Candace Owens is facing renewed criticism after a viral X post accused her of dragging innocent people into her coverage of the Charlie Kirk investigation and promoting conspiracy theories. The criticism came as Owens addressed claims involving Frank Turek, saying viewers could judge his remarks for themselves, while previewing updates about Officer Bagley and Alan Robertson. The exchange has fueled fresh debate over her reporting style and the evidence behind her claims.

title: How Simone Biles’ family helped her become a champion without pressure
content: Simone Biles opens up about how her parents, Ronald and Nellie Biles, helped shape her journey from a young gymnast to one of the greatest athletes in history. The story explores how their support, family balance and focus on happiness helped her handle Olympic pressure, overcome the Tokyo 2021 setback, and return stronger at the Paris 2024 Olympics. It also highlights the role of her NFL husband, Jonathan Owens, during her comeback. Discover the real story behind Biles’ success and how family support became a powerful force throughout her career.

title: Patrick Mahomes reacts as Brittany Mahomes celebrates career milestone
content: Patrick Mahomes showed support for wife Brittany Mahomes while away at Kansas City Chiefs training camp after she celebrated the opening of KC Current Studios. The new media hub aims to spotlight women's sports through original content and athlete storytelling. Brittany attended the launch with their three children, while Patrick reacted to the family's social media post with three blue heart emojis, highlighting his support despite focusing on his NFL comeback.

title: Ramayana to clash with Godzilla Minus Zero on Nov 6 for Imax screens
content: Diwali 2026 will witness a major box office competition between Ramayana and Godzilla Minus Zero.  Both films are scheduled for a worldwide release on November 6, 2026.  Ramayana's pre-Diwali release offers a strong festive window in India.  Godzilla Minus Zero faces significant overseas competition from the Japanese monster franchise.  The battle for premium IMAX screens will be a key talking point for both.

title: Six of family, including two infants, killed as century-old house collapses in UP
content: Six family members perished when their old house roof collapsed early Thursday. Heavy rainfall caused the structure to give way, trapping everyone inside. Alerted neighbours summoned rescue teams who pulled victims from the debris. One man survived the tragic incident and is receiving hospital care. The deceased included two infants and four adults in Pratapgarh district.

title: Consumers already bearing UPI costs indirectly: RBI governor
content: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that the costs of UPI transactions are already subtly included in operations. He expressed it is premature to introduce explicit fees for merchants. The priority lies in enhancing the payment infrastructure and increasing utilization. Any fee implementation should consider potential effects on user engagement and ongoing investment, as consumers do indirectly incur costs, albeit often unnoticed.

title: 'May be jailed, but I’ll return to Bangladesh this December,' says Sheikh Hasina
content: Sheikh Hasina declared she is not afraid of arrest upon her return to Bangladesh in December. She stated her return is for the nation's future and to set it on the right track. Dhaka reacted sharply, calling her an absconding convicted genocider and expressing regret over the event. Hasina described the July Uprising as a regime change operation orchestrated by a mastermind.

title: Meta apologises for ‘error in restricting PM’s video’
content: Meta's CEO Mark Zuckerberg formally apologized to the Indian government over several operational missteps, including issues with paid content amplification. The acknowledgment of these errors comes as officials expressed concerns over the potential loss of safe harbor protection for the platform. As the government reassesses its child online safety regulations, Meta committed to implementing necessary corrective actions to address these concerns.

title: Deal on Hormuz shipping route reached with Oman, says Iran
content: Iran and Oman have agreed on a proposed shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. This agreement is a potential step toward reopening the critical waterway for energy supplies. A joint statement from Tehran and Muscat is currently in the final drafting stage. Sources indicate Iran would gain control over ships entering the Gulf via the strait. Talks continue, but finalization depends on third-party non-obstruction and detailed definitions.

title: Rahane to Sooryavanshi: 'IPL and international cricket are completely different'

Sooryavanshi had a mixed debut tour of England against the hosts. He then bounced back strongly in the T20I series against Zimbabwe. The young opener finished that series as the Player of the Series.

title: 'Respect senior players': Rahane warns Gambhir amid India's Test struggles

title: Ex-Ethiopian Air chief Tewolde Gebremariam becomes Air India CEO

Gebremariam will succeed Campbell Wilson, who stabilized the airline initially. The Tata Group aims for profitable expansion and operational excellence under his leadership. Gebremariam expressed excitement about building a world-class global airline for India.

Tamil Nadu remained the strongest performing market for the film.

title: Government hits out at Pakistan’s malicious propaganda against India

The Indian government asserted that the constitutional changes in Jammu and Kashmir fall within its sovereignty, whilst the global community takes note of the human rights oppression occurring in Pakistan-administered regions. Pakistan is called upon to address ongoing bloodshed and relinquish its illegal occupation of Indian territories.

title: Supreme Court urges states to decide on raising retirement age of judges by Sept 2
content: The Supreme Court urged states to decide on raising trial court judges' retirement age. This move aims to align their superannuation age with that of High Court judges. States were asked to make this decision by September 2, dismissing financial constraint arguments. The court stated that retaining experienced judges offers financial benefits to the government. High Courts were also requested to support this age enhancement initiative.

title: Life's changed in J&K, Ladakh since Article 370, 35(A) repeal: PM Modi
content: Prime Minister Modi emphasised the significant transformation taking place in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh. The repeal of Article 370 opened a new chapter, leading to increased infrastructure and opportunities in the region. Empowerment and constitutional rights have been extended to women and marginalized communities, marking the beginning of a new era characterized by peace and progress for these Union territories.

title: Trai unveils draft service quality norms for network slicing

These anticipated regulations will enable different internet speeds tailored to various user segments, allowing telecom operators to set unique prices for services like 4G and 5G. This development follows appeals from prominent telecom service providers.

title: Government orders blocking of 7,393 links involved in film piracy
content: The government has directed online intermediaries to block 7,393 links involved in film piracy. This action includes the blocking of 4,996 Telegram channels and 1,263 websites. The information and broadcasting ministry disclosed this directive to the Lok Sabha on Wednesday. This move follows amendments to the Cinematograph Act in 2023. The legal framework against online film piracy has been strengthened by the government.

title: ‘Criminal cases can’t have lifespan of turtle’: SC on activist’s trial delay

The activist is charged with fundraising and supporting alleged terrorism, prompting the court to call for a swift resolution to the drawn-out legal proceedings.

title: ‘Miles to go before I sleep’: Omar says ‘wounds of Art 370 abrogation yet to heal’
content: all major political parties in Kashmir held protests and demonstrations, carrying banners and raising slogans . SRINAGAR/JAMMU: Striking a poetic note on the seventh anniversary of the abrogation of Article 370 and bifurcation of the state of jammu & Kashmir into two Union Territories . chief minister Omar Abdullah invoked celebrated american poet Robert Lee Frost as he said wounds caused by the move had still not healed .

title: Cabinet secretary and home secretary get one-year extensions
content: the government gave a one-year extension in service to cabinet secretary TV Somanathan and home secretary Govind Mohan . this is the first such extension for the two key officers at the centre . their fixed tenure of two years was coming to an end this month .
